# Horizon Link Agency

> Faith-driven study abroad consultancy based in Eldoret, Kenya, helping African families access global education opportunities.

Horizon Link Agency, founded by Jonathan K. Kiplagat, guides students through university admissions, scholarships, student visas and settlement support across 10 destination countries. Motto: "By Grace, From Sacrifice to Success."

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, destinations and the Horizon Link journey.
- [About](/about): Story, mission, vision and values of the agency.
- [Services](/services): Study abroad service catalogue.
- [Destinations](/destinations): All 10 study destinations.
- [Contact](/contact): Phones, email, office location and inquiry form.

## Destinations

- [Canada](/destinations/canada): Universities and PGWP/PR pathways.
- [United Kingdom](/destinations/united-kingdom): Russell Group and Graduate Route visa.
- [United States](/destinations/united-states): Ivy League, STEM OPT and scholarships.
- [Australia](/destinations/australia): Group of Eight and skilled migration.
- [Germany](/destinations/germany): Low-tuition public universities and EU Blue Card.
- [Ireland](/destinations/ireland): Tech sector and 2-year stay back.
- [Dubai](/destinations/dubai): Tax-free careers and global branch campuses.
- [Malaysia](/destinations/malaysia): Affordable English-taught and twinning degrees.
- [Malta](/destinations/malta): English-speaking EU member with Schengen access.
- [Qatar](/destinations/qatar): Education City and tax-free job market.
